bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to children and families; appropriating money for a grant to Greater Minneapolis Council of Churches for site selection and property acquisition for a new services and supports facility.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+APPROPRIATION; GREATER MINNEAPOLIS COUNCIL OF CHURCHES SERVICES AND SUPPORTS FACILITY. +]

[+$3,000,000 in fiscal year 2027 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of children, youth, and families for a grant to Greater Minneapolis Council of Churches, a 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization, to acquire property for and to predesign, design, construct, furnish, and equip a new services and supports facility in the city of Minneapolis to be used for establishing a dedicated food shelf and youth programming space. Greater Minneapolis Council of Churches may work with Southside Community Health Services for the use of the space. This is a onetime appropriation and is available until the project is completed or abandoned, subject to Minnesota Statutes, section 16A.642. +]

[+EFFECTIVE DATE.+]

[+This section is effective the day following final enactment. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to children and families; appropriating money for a grant to Greater Minneapolis Council of Churches for site selection and property acquisition for a new services and supports facility.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; GREATER MINNEAPOLIS COUNCIL OF CHURCHES SERVICES AND SUPPORTS FACILITY.

$3,000,000 in fiscal year 2027 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of children, youth, and families for a grant to Greater Minneapolis Council of Churches, a 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization, to acquire property for and to predesign, design, construct, furnish, and equip a new services and supports facility in the city of Minneapolis to be used for establishing a dedicated food shelf and youth programming space. Greater Minneapolis Council of Churches may work with Southside Community Health Services for the use of the space. This is a onetime appropriation and is available until the project is completed or abandoned, subject to Minnesota Statutes, section 16A.642.

EFFECTIVE DATE.

This section is effective the day following final enactment.
